script_hooks.logic:
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v be call helper.
  If v, then
    Let ability be the id of the move labelled "eraser" on the enemy.
    (call game:Commander.getInstance) → register with (ability, the enemy, {activeTarget: v}, {interruptBoss: true}).
Return the default update step of Simple-state.
